commands.prepare-cell: Emit exact frozen rendered storage and exact 25-key dispatch-attempt storage; never write.
commands.validate-prestart: Reopen render, attempt, run/freeze/addendum/schedules, every prior same-slot PASS seal, no downstream evidence, and run-wide nonce/thread/turn uniqueness before the one continuous launch transaction.
commands.run-subject: Future-only subject call through the isolated v9 app-server primitive after exact prestart and run-contract launch authorization; emit receipt-v4 storage and never persist it.
commands.emit-capture: Derive unchanged capture-v3 from a valid reopened receipt-v4 with zero subject calls.
commands.score-cell: Run the unchanged pure scorer from reopened capture/receipt/render evidence and emit canonical score storage.
commands.emit-completion: Reopen every prior chain member and emit completion-v3 last; schedule advance remains false until independent reopen.
commands.validate-cell: Independently reopen and byte-validate the exact full chain and completion-v3.
commands.recover-state: Classify exact no-start, permanent invalid, zero-call resumable, or sealed state without repair/relaunch.
commands.emit-artifact: Run an unchanged deterministic reducer and emit a create-only stage artifact proposal.
commands.validate-artifact: Reopen and recompute one deterministic reducer artifact.
commands.validate-path: Reopen 97 PASS cell seals and 18 deterministic artifacts for one route.
commands.validate-matrix: Reopen three complete clean routes and 291 cell seals.
commands.validate-two-runs: Require sequence 1 then sequence 2 with identical freeze/protocol and reopen both matrices.
commands.self-test: Execute closed-world zero-call predecessor, successor, recovery, live-process, historical, dependency, and 97/97 semantic gates.

run_contract_rules.launch_authority: exact create-only run contract plus exact frozen manifest and predeclared dispatch schedule; no per-cell authorization artifact

causal_admission.prior_cells: every earlier same-slot cell has exact completion-v3, PASS score, and reopened chain hashes/bytes
causal_admission.downstream_cells: no evidence file may exist before current dispatch
causal_admission.identity: all 291 dispatch nonces unique; every persisted thread_id and turn_id unique across the run
causal_admission.recovery: attempt without receipt after process loss is permanent invalid and never relaunched; valid receipt makes capture/score/completion zero-call resumable

preflight_open_audit.scope: semantic imports, renderer, oracle, scorer, reducers, and zero-call recovery suite
preflight_open_audit.rule: every observed successor-root file must be in the exact hash/byte dependency closure; every live Plans/** open is rejected
preflight_open_audit.reported_evidence: sorted observed paths with exact SHA-256/bytes and aggregate inventory

nonclaims: No audit, freeze, subject launch, empirical credit, qualification, or readiness claim.
The deterministic preflight does not authorize a canary or matrix.
